testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, navigation tabs, inputs, cards, reel action buttons) MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly build using Expo React Native UI components (View, Text, Pressable, Image, ScrollView, FlatList). Do not inject React web HTML tags like div, span, button.
Ensure dark/light contrast is crisp and text readability conforms to APCA/WCAG standards.
Maintain the exact persistent 5-department top strip across screens except full-screen product reels.
The center bottom nav button must strictly implement the black circle + lime numeral '1' design branding.
Always attach data-testid props to all pressable and input elements for testing agent automation.
